question: Patients who quit statins over side effects took statin, dummy and no pills in rotating months. How much statin-month symptom burden appeared on dummy pills?
answer: About 90%. The 2020 SAMSON trial gave 60 people twelve monthly bottles, four each of atorvastatin, placebo and nothing, and they scored symptoms daily. Empty months were easy; dummy months hurt almost as much as statin months. Shown their own charts, about half went back on statins.
move: Compare the bad months with the months you took nothing at all.
trap: Believing aches that began with the drug must come from the drug.
